goals.evidence: Order-to-license chain tested with isolated auth/store + injected fake KlikQRIS (no real payment, no production DB): server/test/cost-integrity.test.js (A1: body amount/description rejected 400; price+entitlement resolved server-side from plan catalogue; unknown/inactive 400; custom/zero-price 409; verified settle issues license with PLAN entitlement incl. custom features + 30d expiry), server/test/server.test.js (webhook forged PAID rejected via upstream re-verification; verified SUCCESS settles; idempotent second delivery issues no duplicate license), NEW server/test/orders-ownership.test.js (authenticated account gets 404 on another account's order; /api/orders/latest empty for fresh account; cost-integrity 400 under real session), server/test/account.test.js (accountId accepted, grouterApiKey never in sanitized license). goals.title: Admin and settings security
goals.objective: Adversarially test admin auth, secret masking, D-020, ownership, validation, webhook re-verification and neutral errors using fake credentials/upstream only.
goals.evidence: Adversarial admin/settings testing with fake credentials/upstream only: NEW 9-route admin auth sweep in server/test/server.test.js (stats/licenses issue/bind/revoke/order settle/settings GET+PATCH/usage all 401 with missing AND wrong Bearer token; 200 with correct token proving sweep gates on auth not 404s). Secret masking: server/test/settings.test.js (GET masks secrets, masked round-trip keeps stored secret, 401 without token). D-020 SSOT: server/test/settings-wiring.test.js (env seeds < store precedence; stored payment credentials reach KlikQRIS headers without exposure; stored license audience used for issued-token validation). Webhook re-verification: forged PAID ignored (unverified upstream), verified SUCCESS settles (server.test.js). Ownership: session-scoped order reads 404 cross-account (orders-ownership.test.js). Neutral errors: cost-integrity 400/409 messages carry no internals. Context redaction hardened: grouterApiKey key + gRouter- format scrubbed. Backend 44/44, root 101/101. No production credentials touched.
